about.details: Searches the files under a folder for a text pattern, fast. It skips what .gitignore hides, and binary files, unless told otherwise.

steps.acquire: Downloads upstream's static release archive and checks it against the digest published with the release.
steps.build: Nothing is compiled: the archive is unpacked and each file is checked against its own digest.
steps.install: Puts rg, its manual page and its licences in place.

recipes.description: Fast recursive text search with rg
recipes.name: ripgrep
